title: Tankbook vehicle catalog pack
description: A pack the operator publishes into vehicle_catalog (docs/API.md 'Vehicle catalog'). Validated against this schema AT PUBLISH TIME on the server, whole or not at all, so a malformed pack never reaches a device and the previously published pack keeps serving. The schema enforces structure and types only - it never interprets what a field means (CLAUDE.md hard rule 9): the server curates this data, and an offer set like fuelKinds is listed, not decided.

packVersion.description: Monotonic pack version; a version not greater than the currently published one is refused (rollback protection, docs/SYNC.md 'Applying an update').

id.description: Stable identity across packs: publishing the same id again corrects the entry in place (docs/SYNC.md 'The master rule').

generation.description: The model line's generation label, or null when the line has none.

years.description: Production years as an inclusive [firstYear, lastYear] pair, or null. Stored as an int4range with inclusive bounds.

fuelKinds.description: The OFFER SET the model line is sold with (docs/SCHEMA.md 'Vehicle catalog') - petrol95/diesel/lpg/... - never the fuel of one car. Non-empty.
